articles.title: 1 person killed in serious Hwy. 400 crash

articles.title: Man rushed to hospital after North York stabbing
articles.summary: A man was rushed to a hospital overnight following a stabbing in North York. Police were called to the area of Yonge Street and Sheppard Avenue East just after 1:30 a.m. on Saturday. When officers arrived at the scene, they located a man with injuries, and he was transported to a hospital in non-life-threatening condition. […]

articles.title: Mississauga councillors want to pause data centre builds for a year. Here's why
articles.summary: With data centre builds remaining a hot-topic in Ontario municipalities, some Mississauga city councillors are concerned about the uncertainty surrounding what the centres could mean for the community and the environment.

articles.summary: Police in Hamilton have received judicial authorization to name a 15-year-old suspect wanted in connection with a double-shooting in Stoney Creek. Officers were called to Candlewood Drive, in east‑Hamilton, at around 2:30 a.m. on July 29, where they located two males suffering from gunshot wounds. articles.title: Nurse preceptor charged with sexual assault against nursing student in Markham: police
articles.summary: A 58-year-old registered nurse preceptor has been charged with sexual assault against a nursing student in Markham, police say.

articles.title: Man charged with 2nd-degree murder in shooting of security guard at Pickering casino
articles.summary: A 20-year-old man is facing a second-degree murder charge in the killing of Michael Ferdinand, who was shot while on the job at Pickering Casino Resort.

articles.title: Caribbean Carnival is back in Toronto for the long weekend. Here's what you need to know
articles.summary: As the annual celebration returns, there will be lots on the go this weekend, including the Grand Parade, which will shut down several downtown roads. Toronto police say they are deploying additional officers for this weekend's festivities, which come weeks after a deadly shooting at another popular cultural festival.

articles.title: Hundreds of casino workers on strike in Ajax, Pickering
articles.summary: About 900 workers from the Casino Ajax and Pickering Casino Resort are on strike after a tentative agreement was struck down by the workers’ union earlier this week.

articles.title: Man charged with 1st-degree murder in 2006 Scarborough cold case
articles.summary: Toronto police say they've arrested and charged a Hamilton man with first-degree murder in a Scarborough cold case dating back two decades, thanks to modern day forensic technology.

articles.title: Ontario announces funding for new medical school to train family doctors
articles.summary: Colleges and Universities Minister Nolan Quinn says the province is providing $55.8 million for York University's new school of medicine. He says the funds will help the school hire faculty, build a medical library and operate its undergraduate and graduate programs.
